title: P00 local Ollama structured draft proposals with host-controlled path validation
summary: Introduced explicit loopback Ollama structured JSON planning with untrusted response schema checks, phase/task binding, protected workspace draft paths and fixed read-only checks. Added mocked Linux/Windows model tests and protected planner/host authority files. No actual model-backed file edit, OS sandbox, worker deployment or GitHub mutation.
migration_notes: No data migration. New proposal-only local API adapter does not execute patches or retain model prompts.
